personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure with 4 Tactile / Playful warmth and pastel accents
personality_one_liner: A neat, clean, and highly scannable commerce experience grounded in warm pastel tones and inviting food-first photography.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for scanning items rapidly, tight grouping within product cards.

do's: Bottom tab bar (when content scrolls behind it)
Pinned filter rows in food listing
Floating action buttons for group cart actions

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Primary discovery hub driving user intent to food, groceries, and shared community orders.

states.loading: Centered brand-colored spinner with a subtle bouncing icon.
states.empty: Not applicable for Home unless location is unsupported (show 'We are not here yet' illustration).
states.error: Readable network error message + Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with location selector and search bar. Below header: Grid of quick-access icons (Food, Groceries, Group Order, Community). Horizontal carousels for 'Trending Near Me' and promotional pastel-tinted cards. Use `brandTertiary` background for highlighted offers.

screens.name: Group_Cart
screens.purpose: A collaborative split-bill cart for roommates/bachelors to order together with a scheduled cutoff time.

states.loading: Skeleton rows of cart items and member avatars.
states.empty: Illustration of friends sharing a meal + 'Start a group order' primary CTA.
states.error: Failed to sync cart error + Retry button.

screens.layout: Top section: Countdown timer and list of participant avatars. Middle section: Drag-and-drop itemized list showing who claimed what (avatars next to items). Bottom: Sticky CTA displaying total group amount and individual 'Your Share' amount to proceed.

screens.name: Community_Basket
screens.purpose: Apartment community bulk order screen showing consolidated orders broken down by flat numbers.

states.empty: Empty basket illustration + 'Start your community order' CTA.
states.error: Could not fetch community details + Retry button.

screens.layout: Header with Apartment name and total items. List of grouped accordion cards (each card represents a flat). Expanding a flat shows their specific items. Sticky bottom bar with 'Close Community Order' CTA.

screens.name: Reels_Feed
screens.purpose: Full-screen vertical scrolling feed for discovering local businesses and food via short-form video.

states.loading: Dark placeholder with a loading spinner.
states.error: Failed to load feed + Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-screen video player (safe area respected for overlays). Right-side vertical floating action bar (Like, Share, Store profile). Bottom overlay with glassmorphism containing 'Add to Cart' or 'View Menu' CTA.

screens.name: Cart_Checkout
screens.purpose: Standard e-commerce checkout flow verifying items, applying offers, and selecting address.

states.empty: Empty cart icon with 'Your cart is feeling lonely' text and a CTA to browse food.

screens.layout: Vertical list: Items summary, Bill details (Subtotal, taxes, delivery fee), Apply coupon section, Address selector, and a sticky bottom CTA to Pay.

hero_food.alt: Delicious burger and fries for food delivery hero card

hero_grocery.alt: Fresh organic vegetables basket for grocery hero card

group_order_empty.alt: Friends sharing a meal for group order empty state

community_cover.alt: Modern apartment complex for community basket header

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' structure with '4 Tactile/Playful' pastel warmth. Use Swiggy-like clean UI elements: plenty of whitespace, highly scannable item cards, and pastel accent backgrounds (`brandTertiary`) for promotional cards.
Implement a 4-tab bottom navigation: Home, Reels, Cart, Account. Use Phosphor icons (outlined for inactive, filled for active).
For the Group Cart screen, implement a clear visual hierarchy differentiating 'Total Group Amount' and 'Your Share'. Use sticky bottom sheets for CTAs.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, cards) have minimum 44x44pt touch targets.
Use `expo-image` with gradient scrims overlay when rendering text directly on top of images (e.g., hero_food, community_cover).
Avoid standard AI-looking generic blue/purple palettes. Stick strictly to the defined warm orange/peach (`brand`, `brandTertiary`) palette.
Follow structured layouts observed in competitive apps like Swiggy, using clear location and search intent elements at the top of the Home layout.
